title: Signature: Fallback ancestry
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every request served by a fallback records its ancestry: which tool was preferred, which fallback served it, and why the switch happened. Ancestry travels with the result so downstream consumers and auditors can see the full substitution chain. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers recording preferred-tool to fallback substitutions.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 2, 2: 3, 3: 4}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
chain = ["preferred:search-v2"]
for i in range(N):
    chain.append("fallback-%d:reason=%s" % (i + 1, ["timeout", "5xx", "overload", "deploy"][i % 4]))
print("ancestry:", " -> ".join(chain))

title: Signature: Fallback confidence scoring
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every degraded result carries a confidence score derived from the fallback rung, data freshness, and historical accuracy of that path. Consumers set their own minimum confidence, and results below it are withheld rather than served misleadingly. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers scoring degraded results from rung, freshness, and history.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"rung": 1, "fresh": 0.9}, 2: {"rung": 2, "fresh": 0.6}, 3: {"rung": 3, "fresh": 0.4}}
rung, fresh = CFG[LEVEL]["rung"], CFG[LEVEL]["fresh"]
history = {1: 0.95, 2: 0.85, 3: 0.70}[rung]
conf = round(0.5 * (1.0 / rung) + 0.3 * fresh + 0.2 * history, 3)
decision = "serve" if conf >= 0.5 else "withhold"
print("rung:", rung, "| freshness:", fresh, "| confidence:", conf, "->", decision)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
